claim: Swaps the character for a comedy design rather than applying an effect to them, which is why it belongs in its own variable. Chibi is the reset-the-stakes joke; noodle limbs and head pop are the ones that keep a character recognisable while breaking their anatomy.
method: identical subject sentence and seed in every panel; only the option clause changes. panels marked control render the untouched subject, because SDXL cannot express absence.

panels.clause: oversized head, exaggerated head to body proportions
chibi inset panel, small super deformed figure in a corner box
